summaryZh: Bria Long 的个人 Research 页探讨儿童绘画如何反映视觉概念，以及婴儿日常视觉输入如何影响早期学习；其中举例分析儿童数字绘画和婴儿第一人称视频。该页混合个人既往与合作项目，尚不能确认为 Long Lab 当前的整体研究范围。

evidence.quote: What might children’s drawings reveal about how they represent the visual concepts in the world around them?

For this project, I collected over 37,000 digital children’s drawings behaviors via an iPad interface, and analyzed the category-diagnostic information in these drawings using both embeddings from deep neural networks and human annotations of the recognizable object parts in each stroke.

This line of work records and analyzes videos taken from the infant perspective with modern computer vision models, aiming to understand the natural structure in the visual input and how this structure scaffolds early learning.
I'm an Assistant Professor in the Department of Psychology at the University of California, San Diego (see lab page at vislearnlab.org ) .
